# Test fixtures

## `fake-gh/`

A stand-in for the GitHub CLI. Tests that put this directory ahead of the real
`gh` on `PATH` exercise jjj's whole GitHub integration with no network, no
credentials, and no shared repository — see `tests/github_sync_test.rs`.

Two environment variables drive it:

- `FAKE_GH_LOG` — append one record per invocation (the argv, newlines escaped).
  Tests assert on this to check *how* `gh` was called, which stdout cannot show.
- `FAKE_GH_STATE` — a directory for mutable state, so a close in one command is
  visible to the `view` in the next.

An unrecognized subcommand exits non-zero and names the argv, so a new call site
fails loudly here instead of silently returning empty output.

## `corpus-0.3/`, `corpus-0.4/`

Metadata trees as **actually written** by those releases, used by
`tests/format_compat_test.rs` to prove that upgrading the binary does not make an
existing repository unreadable. Users upgrade jjj; they do not migrate their
data.

These were generated by building the release and running it — not hand-written
to match what the schema is remembered to be, which would test our memory rather
than the format.

To regenerate (or to add a corpus for a new release):

```sh
# Pick the commit that bumped the version, e.g. 0.4.1 -> 48866f3
git worktree add --detach /tmp/wt-041 48866f3
cd /tmp/wt-041 && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/target-041 cargo build

# Drive the old binary through a small, representative project
cd "$(mktemp -d)"
git init -q . && git config user.name Alice && git config user.email a@e.com
git commit -q --allow-empty -m init
jj git init --colocate && jj config set --repo user.name Alice
/tmp/target-041/debug/jjj init
/tmp/target-041/debug/jjj milestone new "v1.0"
/tmp/target-041/debug/jjj problem new "Session tokens never expire" \
    --priority critical --tags security,auth --force
/tmp/target-041/debug/jjj problem new "Slow dashboard" --priority medium \
    --milestone "v1.0" --force
/tmp/target-041/debug/jjj solution new "Add a 24h TTL" \
    --problem "Session tokens" --force
/tmp/target-041/debug/jjj critique new "Add a 24h TTL" \
    "Refresh tokens need rotation" --severity high

cp -R .jj/jjj-meta/{problems,solutions,critiques,milestones} \
      .jj/jjj-meta/{config.toml,events.jsonl} \
      <jjj>/tests/fixtures/corpus-X.Y/
git worktree remove /tmp/wt-041
```

Keep the entity titles identical across corpora — `assert_corpus_loads` in the
test asserts against them by name.
